account.protocolJmapHint: Your server speaks JMAP: faster, lighter, and new mail flies in instantly ✧
account.errorImapDisabled: Microsoft won’t let me in (´･_･`) IMAP is switched off for this mailbox — only an administrator can flip it: Set-CASMailbox -Identity ADDRESS -ImapEnabled $true

settings.addonsEmptyTitle: No addons yet, so much potential (✧ω✧)
settings.motionDesc: Should Nyu blink, hop and fly around? With System, I follow your operating system.
settings.trustedSendersEmpty: Nobody on my list yet (・・ )? Add senders right in the image notice of a message.
settings.runInBackgroundDesc: Closing the window lets Nyu nap next to the clock and keep watch for new mail. Quit from the icon there.
settings.backgroundPushDesc: Nyu stays awake and watches your mailbox. Android shows a quiet notification for that, which you can hide ♡
settings.linkConfirmDesc: I'll show you where a link from a mail goes first. Disguised links always get a question.
settings.linkDomainsDesc: I let links to these sites straight through, unless they're in disguise.
settings.linkDomainsEmpty: None yet. You add sites right when you open a link ✧
settings.linkDomainsInactive: Right now I let every link straight through.
settings.syncAccountDesc: Look, language, pictures, links and signatures travel with your UwUMail account, into the app on every device and into the webmail ✧ Layout, density, swipes, app lock and updates stay here with me. Turning off the question before links or the image blocker only applies on the device where you do it – better safe than sorry!
settings.syncNone: Hmm, none of your accounts lives on a UwUMail server that remembers settings (・・ )? So everything stays here.
settings.syncOffline: {{email}} isn’t answering right now. I’ll hold on to your changes and send them once it’s back (｡•̀ᴗ-)✧
settings.syncRefused: The server doesn’t take {{count}} settings. They stay on this device.
settings.signatureLocalOnlyDesc: This one stays with me on this device: too big to travel (256 KB at most) or with pictures that only work here.

attachment.dangerTitle: Careful! This file could start programs (・_・;)
